title: Research stream evidence for Main
description: Canonical structured return and evidence fields. Shape validation is not retrieval or support validation. Status meanings and methodology gates are in synthesis-and-reporting.md. Omit nonmaterial metadata rather than inventing it.

assignment.description: Exact assignment ID from Main; never merge fixed streams.

discovered.description: Exact action refs actually discovered and described in this child, not inherited claims of availability.

calls.description: One receipt per actual retrieval action invocation, including failed calls and get_search_content. A multi-query search or multi-URL fetch is one invocation, not one source. Receipts are worker reports until checked against host evidence or independently retrieved by Main.

args.description: Exact nonsecret retrieval arguments, without provider overrides or browser auth.

retrieved.description: Actual successful retrieval, not merely a resolved promise or isError:false.

detail.description: Observed successful/total counts, tool-specific errors, or content-match outcome.

responseId.description: Actual responseId, or web_search details.searchId; session-local unless independently shown portable.

rows.description: Only material claims, separately assessable; no final cross-stream recommendation from workers.

id.description: Unique within assignment. Main prefixes with assignment ID.

slot.description: Exact required output-slot ID supplied by Main.

finding.description: Smallest material assertion, exact value or bounded result.

support.description: Original direct sources actually retrieved; an empty array cannot support a decisive external claim.

url.description: Direct supporting URL, never a fabricated citation or retrieval handle alone.

passage.description: Exact decisive passage or table text with necessary headers, units and context; no paraphrase disguised as quotation.

locator.description: Section, table/page or content offset sufficient to relocate support.

origin.description: Original evidence origin. Syndication, workers or URLs repeating one paper/run count once.

sourceType.description: Primary documentation, independent measurement, vendor evaluation, paper, community report; relevant funding/vendor relationship if known.

date.description: Publication/revision/effective date or version when material; label which, do not guess.

responseId.description: Useful local expansion handle, not proof of cross-session accessibility.

counterevidence.description: Strongest material contradiction or bounded search gap, not an invented absence.

method.description: Applicable task/sample/settings/metric and direct relevance or transfer limits.

comparability.description: Material differences or missing fields and resulting comparison limits; mark not applicable when appropriate.

confidence.description: Qualitative strength plus evidence-based reason, separate from status/provenance; no fabricated probabilities.

disposition.description: Evidence disposition, provisional until Main checks support and method.

gaps.description: Named missing owned requirements, contradictions, access/budget limits and highest-impact resolving check.

stopReason.description: Actual sufficient-support, diminishing-return, access, budget or blocked-conclusion reason. Budget stops are not evidence saturation.
